content.short: El Dorado is a Latin American app offering dollar accounts, currency exchange and card payments.
content.description: El Dorado gives users in more than a dozen Latin American countries a dollar-denominated account, currency exchange and card spending in one app, built on stablecoins underneath. Dollar access is the core proposition in markets where holding local currency carries real inflation risk.
content.meta: Dollar accounts, FX and card spending across a dozen Latin American countries, built on stablecoins.
